summary.text: Sacker of cities and father of Iphition, leader of a great host whom a Naiad nymph bore beneath snowy Timolus in the rich land of Hyde — named when Achilles first slew the son in the terrible rout of *Iliad* 20.

story.text: Achilles leapt among the Trojans and first he slew Iphition, the valiant son of Otrynteus, the leader of a great host, whom a Naiad nymph bare to Otrynteus, sacker of cities, beneath snowy Timolus in the rich land of Hyde.
